title: .@TryRivo is building self-driving finance.
summary: .@TryRivo is building self-driving finance. Agents connect to the checking account you already have, learn your cash flow, sweep dollars into Treasury-backed yield, and bring them back before your bills hit. Every dollar earns until the moment you spend it. Why is this hard? Prediction under asymmetric cost. Money returned a day early costs you a little yield. Money returned a day late bounces a bill and destroys trust. @AmbrishTweets is one of the few people who has shipped this class of system before. PhD in AI, 7,000+ citations, built consumer AI at Amazon, and led the L4 autonomy work at Cruise that launched robotaxis, before he came through @spc as a Founder Fellow. Self-driving cars took two decades because the last edge cases were the hard ones. Self-driving money is the same problem with a friendlier failure mode, and the founder building it has already solved the harder version once.
